title: England's national curriculum review misses opportunity to revitalise language learning

sentences: The decline of languages education in England is a familiar and depressing story.
Take-up of French at GCSE is down from 25% in 2009-10 to 18% in 2024-25.
German has halved in the same period from 10% to 5%.
translations: 英格兰语言教育的衰退是一个熟悉且令人沮丧的故事。
法语在GCSE中的选修率从2009-10学年的25%下降到2024-25学年的18%。
德语在同一时期从10%减半至5%。

sentences: There is also a significant gap in take-up at GCSE by disadvantaged pupils (34%) compared with those from more privileged backgrounds (50%).
translations: 在GCSE课程中，弱势学生（34%）与来自更优越背景的学生（50%）之间的参与率也存在显著差距。

sentences: In March 2025, the interim report of a review of England's national curriculum diagnosed languages as a particular problem area.
Languages education was deemed to be furthest away from the principles set out by the review panel.
These included an engaging, coherent, knowledge-rich and inclusive curriculum, and the involvement of teachers in its design and testing.
translations: 2025年3月，一份关于英格兰国家课程评估的中期报告指出，语言学科是一个特别的问题领域。
语言教育被认为最不符合评估小组提出的原则。
这些原则包括一个引人入胜、连贯、知识丰富且包容的课程，以及教师参与其设计和测试。

sentences: The review's final report, now published, recommends a much sharper focus on the provision of languages in primary schools.
It encourages a smoother transition from primary to secondary, which has been shown to improve languages take-up even in areas with relatively high numbers of pupils from disadvantaged backgrounds.
translations: 该审查的最终报告现已发布，建议更加注重小学阶段的语言教学。
它鼓励从小学到中学的更平稳过渡，这已被证明即使在来自弱势背景的学生比例较高的地区也能提高语言课程的参与率。

sentences: Its proposal of the introduction of new "stepped" qualifications, where learners can build up and bank their progress over time, is promising.
This has been embraced by the government response to the review and organisations such as the UK Association for Language Learning.
translations: 其提出的引入新型“阶梯式”资格认证的建议很有前景，学习者可以逐步积累并储存自己的学习进度。
这一建议已得到政府对此次审查的回应以及英国语言学习协会等组织的采纳。

sentences: The report points to Hackney in London as an example of good practice.
Here, there is a focus on teaching only one language – Spanish – and sharing teacher training and professional development across schools.
Figures show that the local authority had the highest take-up of Spanish across England.
Students were also more likely to continue with languages at GCSE.
translations: 报告指出伦敦的哈克尼区是一个良好实践的范例。
在这里，重点只教授一门语言——西班牙语——并在学校之间共享教师培训和专业发展。
数据显示，该地方当局在英格兰的西班牙语学习参与率最高。
学生们也更有可能在普通中等教育证书考试中继续学习语言。

sentences: A more joined-up approach is welcome.

However, there is a danger that by focusing on a single European language, schools risk ignoring the huge diversity of languages that surround pupils in some of the most multilingual areas of England.
translations: 一种更加协调统一的方法是受欢迎的。
然而，存在一种风险：如果学校只专注于单一欧洲语言，可能会忽视英格兰一些最多元语言地区学生周围存在的巨大语言多样性。

sentences: Celebrating pupils' existing multilingualism brings great benefits.
Research shows embracing the languages spoken by children improves educational outcomes for pupils across subjects such as English, maths and science.
translations: 庆祝学生现有的多语言能力能带来巨大好处。
研究表明，接纳儿童所说的语言能提高学生在英语、数学和科学等学科上的教育成果。

sentences: Some efforts are already being made here.

Charity World of Languages, Languages of the World has created a curriculum which engages with the languages pupils already speak at home in an attempt to dissolve the hierarchy of European languages.
It works with pupils between the ages of seven and 15 to value the study of languages already spoken in communities around schools.
It centres history, culture and communication, while not shying away from contested topics such as migration.
translations: 这里已经做出了一些努力。
慈善机构“语言世界”创建了一套课程，该课程利用学生在家已经使用的语言，试图消除欧洲语言的等级制度。
它与7至15岁的学生合作，重视对学校周边社区已有语言的学习。
它以历史、文化和交流为核心，同时不回避诸如移民等有争议的话题。

sentences: Yet, despite initiatives like this, there is no mention in the curriculum review of that wider sphere of languages that constitutes such a rich tapestry of multicultural life in towns and cities across England.
translations: 然而，尽管有这样的举措，课程审查中并未提及那些更广泛的语言领域，而这些语言构成了英格兰城镇中丰富多彩的多元文化生活的图景。

sentences: A core caveat within the curriculum review stems from recent changes made to the existing curriculum for French, German and Spanish GCSEs.
This new curriculum has not yet reached its first examinations, which will happen in summer 2026.
The review recommends the evaluation of that new GCSE at the end of its first teaching cycle in 2026.
translations: 课程审查中的一个核心警告源于近期对法语、德语和西班牙语GCSE现有课程所做的修改。
这一新课程尚未迎来首次考试，该考试将于2026年夏季进行。
审查建议在2026年首个教学周期结束时对该新GCSE进行评估。

sentences: This will be an important moment for teachers to offer feedback on the new specification.

The previous languages curriculum received criticism for excluding pupils from disadvantaged backgrounds because exam questions asked for responses based on personal experience, such as describing holidays.
Teacher feedback will show whether the government has met its stated aims to make the new curriculum more accessible and relevant for pupils.
translations: 这将是教师对新规范提供反馈的重要时刻。
之前的语言课程因将来自弱势背景的学生排除在外而受到批评，因为考试题目要求基于个人经历作答，例如描述假期。
教师的反馈将显示政府是否实现了其既定目标，即让新课程对学生更易获取且更具相关性。

sentences: It might also be the moment for the government to consider more explicit inclusion of culture in the curriculum at GCSE.

How an enhanced awareness of the effects of climate change and the development of digital skills can be built into the study of languages, in line with the review's wider recommendations, should also be on the table.
For instance, language classes could include discussing how the social and political contexts of climate change differ internationally, including in Indigenous cultures.
translations: 现在也可能是政府考虑在普通中等教育证书课程中更明确地纳入文化内容的时机。
如何根据审查的更广泛建议，将对气候变化影响的增强意识和数字技能的发展融入语言学习中，也应提上议程。
例如，语言课程可以包括讨论气候变化的社会和政治背景在国际上（包括在土著文化中）有何不同。

sentences: Finally, the curriculum review revisits what many experts see as the disastrous decision by the government in 2004 to make languages non-compulsory at GCSE.
But it stops short of recommending languages become compulsory once again.
translations: 最后，课程审查重新审视了2004年政府做出的、被许多专家视为灾难性的决定——将语言课程从GCSE必修科目中移除。
但审查并未建议将语言课程重新列为必修科目。

sentences: This is a shame.
According to polling by YouGov, taking a compulsory language learning is supported by a clear majority of Britons.
What's more, research has estimated that removing the language barrier with Arabic, Chinese, French and Spanish-speaking countries could increase UK exports annually by about £19 billion.
translations: 这真遗憾。
根据YouGov的民意调查，绝大多数英国人支持强制学习语言。
此外，研究估计，消除与阿拉伯语、中文、法语和西班牙语国家的语言障碍，每年可使英国出口增加约190亿英镑。

sentences: Making a language compulsory at GCSE would also help arrest the now catastrophic decline in languages uptake across the educational pipeline, as university languages departments face closure.
translations: 将一门语言列为GCSE必修课也将有助于遏制当前语言学习在整个教育体系中灾难性的下滑趋势，因为大学语言系正面临关闭的困境。

sentences: Most importantly, promoting the study of languages would foster more nuanced, culturally and linguistically informed responses to the sorts of divisive political discourse increasingly on display in Britain today.
Learning languages promotes cross-cultural understanding and tolerance of ambiguity in an increasingly ambiguous world.
translations: 最重要的是，推广语言学习将有助于培养对当今英国日益显现的分裂性政治话语做出更细致、更具文化和语言洞察力的回应。
学习语言能促进跨文化理解，并在一个日益模糊的世界中培养对模糊性的包容。
